findings.title: Team admins and owners are incorrectly required to hold both roles
findings.body: This uses `&&` between the admin and owner checks, so a user must be both a team admin and a team owner to pass this authorization branch. Admin-only and owner-only users are denied even though the booking UI treats admins or owners as authorized. Use an OR condition so the API matches the intended permission.

findings.title: Blacklist checks can be bypassed by changing email case
findings.body: The blacklist entries are lowercased, but `guest` is compared without normalization. Email addresses are case-insensitive for delivery, so a blacklisted address submitted with uppercase letters bypasses this check and is added and emailed. Normalize the submitted address before checking the blacklist.

findings.title: Guests can be added to bookings that are no longer active
findings.body: The handler updates attendees without checking the booking status. A direct API call can add guests to a cancelled or rejected booking, after which the handler sends confirmed calendar invitations for that event. Reject bookings whose status does not permit adding guests before writing attendee records.

findings.title: Calendar update failures leave attendee records committed without notifications
findings.body: Attendee records are committed at line 92 before this external calendar update. If the calendar provider call throws, the mutation fails and execution never reaches the email send, but the guests remain in the database; retrying with those guests can then fail as duplicates. Handle this failure consistently, for example by rolling back the write or recording a retryable calendar/email job.

findings.title: Email notifications use the unfiltered guest list
findings.body: `guests` can include addresses already attending the booking, but those addresses are removed from `uniqueGuests` before insertion. Passing the original list to `sendAddGuestsEmails` makes the email code treat those existing attendees as newly added and send them a normal scheduled-booking email when the request also includes a genuinely new guest. Pass the filtered list instead.
